pompiers.name: La caserne des pompiers
pompiers.alt: The ground-floor engine hall and sunny cobbled training yard of the village fire station on Place de la Mairie, painted in ink and gouache: on the left inside the open red-brick bay a firefighter in bulky turnout gear is stuck halfway down the shiny brass fire pole while a smiling female firefighter below holds out a round red rescue trampoline under the window; in the left foreground a ginger cat sits on a red alarm box purring into a brass horn as two junior trainees jog the wrong way, a clumsy firefighter kicks over a water bucket with his boot while a wet black cat glares at him, and a beaver in a yellow safety helmet tightens a brass hose clamp with a wrench; in the middle an open stone archway leads out to Place de la Mairie with its trees and obelisk, and in front of it a firefighter waves a warning below a white cat clinging to the top of a wooden utility pole with a yellow lightning-bolt sign; on the right firefighter Dan points up at a blue jay tangled in the brass station bell's rope, a firefighter atop a red fire truck's ladder reaches toward a tabby kitten on a stone ledge two feet higher than the top rung, a white fire van extends its long ladder all the way to the onion dome of a white model Taj Mahal, a daring striped cat leaps mid-air between two big red wheeled hose reels while a firefighter gasps, and two firefighters in the front right corner spray water from a brass hose onto a blazing wooden training barn while a farmer and his spotted cow watch safely behind a fence.
